hearingId.description: the seed hearing id (i.e. the id of the hearing being shared)

bookingReferencesWithCourtScheduleIds.description: bookingReferences progression resolved and stored at an earlier share, with the court schedule ids each one holds. Populated only on a re-share, where freeing the previous hearing's slots has erased the rows that tied those references to their sessions, leaving this replayed copy as the only record; listing falls back to it when courtscheduler no longer knows a reference. Empty for a first share, and for a booking that expired before it was ever shared, so neither changes behaviour. Optional: absent on commands built before this field existed.
